scope: Observable main-chat contracts apply to every agent; missing evidence is a failure, never a policy exemption. Fixture evidence is not live/browser evidence.

derivation.method: main branch source, server test inventory, UX tests/browser suites, merge/commit subjects and loaded chat/release skills

policies.rule: Private agent history, memory and home are invisible to standard agents. Do not test against existing private agents; use fresh disposable synthetic data.
Agent model allowlists and restricted-provider unsupported combinations remain enforced; test an allowed model, never exempt the whole model picker.
An explicit files:none grant refuses attachments; files:own must support attached bytes. Do not count unavailable placement as policy.
Restricted runtime must use its per-agent Unix socket and edge transport; no host TCP fallback.

features.description: The optional signed Android companion preserves each routed reply while asynchronously stopping and parking its native recording.
features.how_to_test: In wizard-ux run node --test tests/shell-recording-routes.test.mjs. The real parkReply function runs for main, host-profile, container and restricted routes with asynchronous shell and synchronous full-app recorders; it preserves session, agent, typed draft and audio, and acknowledges only after durable held custody. Meeting cancellation also awaits native bytes before acknowledgement. This is synthetic source-executed evidence, not live provider or physical-phone proof. Companion UX PR: humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#504.

features.description: Agent-owned thread collections persist independently of agent runtime kind
features.how_to_test: PUT a named Space with canonical thread ids via owner preferences, restart, read exact membership back, then delete the collection without touching sessions. In wizard-ux, node --test tests/space-members.test.mjs checks missing-member hydration for main, host-profile, container and restricted routes, scope changes, hidden/private discovery, 500 members and bounded polling. QA_SPACE_MEMBERS_ONLY=1 node qa-chats-focus.cjs <origin> verifies phone/desktop Focus shows 82 visible members with 62 archived beyond the global archive-50, keeps All windowed and preserves Back. These are fixture/browser checks, not live runtime proof.
